verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any Rollbar integration with Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear, and does not describe two-way status sync where closing a ticket resolves an error or a regression reopens it. The PagerDuty incident create/update/resolve feature is a different incident-management integration, and webhooks and the REST API are only building blocks. None of these earn credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can link an error to Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear with two-way status sync, so fixing the ticket resolves the error and a regression reopens it
